'''Jüri Kärner''' (25 April 1940 – 25 September 2010) was an [[Estonia]]n biologist.<ref name="ut.ee">{{cite web |title=Raamatu "Rektor Jüri Kärner" esitlus ja professor Kärneri elektronmikroskoopia fotode näituse avamine – Rahvusülikool 100 |url=https://100.ut.ee/ajakava/raamatu-rektor-juri-karner-esitlus/ |website=ut.ee |access-date=13 July 2021 |language=et}}</ref>

1988-1993 he was the [[rector of Tartu University]].<ref name="ut.ee" />

Awards:
* 1997: [[Order of the National Coat of Arms]], III class.<ref name="president.ee">{{cite web |title=Teenetemärkide kavalerid: Alfred Koort|url=https://www.president.ee/et/vabariik/teenetemargid/kavaler/898/juri-karner |website=www.president.ee |access-date=13 July 2021}}</ref>
